086f1325383b6f754bcc8547b7ceca0399084c46.explanation: DFS Secretary Sanjay Lohiya ne banks, NBFCs aur insurers ko aapas me milkar kaam karne ki salah di hai. 8985cbe889cc2c60966fd221a617ce775f364d77.explanation: Indian Rupee pichhle 8 saal me apne sabse acche monthly gains ki taraf badh raha hai. November me ab tak Rupee best-performing Asian currency ban gaya hai. Isi ke sath bond yields me bhi kami aayi hai.

3b18704542821a79c9500a34be8414bebe3e29ae.hinglish_title: TrueRE Oriana Power Lagayega ₹750 Crore Ka Investment Paanch CBG Projects Me
3b18704542821a79c9500a34be8414bebe3e29ae.explanation: Renewable energy company TrueRE Oriana Power paanch compressed biogas plants lagane ke liye ₹750 crore invest karegi. In plants ki kul capacity 110 tonnes per day hogi. Ye projects agle do saal ke dauran Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh aur Gujarat me shuru kiye jayenge.

04506b6f6e6d4a258df6424a6a73d12ac346ab1f.explanation: Reliance-backed genomics company Strand apne blood-based cancer test CancerSpot ke liye US FDA approval lene me lagi hai. 49ecfba274323ad5b70161df113a2af8c6694013.explanation: All India Gem and Jewellery Domestic Council ne BIS ko gold me Rhenium aur Iridium alloys milane ki reports par alert kiya hai. Is tarike se sone ki purity badhaye bina sirf uska wazan badhane ka arop hai. GJC ne industry aur buyers ko satark rehne aur kisi bhi shaqi mamle ki complaint darj karne ko kaha hai.

Major borrowers mehenge karz se bachne ke liye pehle hi funds raise kar rahe hain.

4e96a5a78ea7356fa4963286b2456193b9ea2322.explanation: Healthcare venture capital firm Alkemi Growth Capital March se June 2027 ke beech apna teesra fund launch karne ki yojana bana rahi hai. Yeh limit aggregate receipts par nahi, balki har individual transaction par lagu hogi.

77d1295986ef1e79e1cca938316f20fbe087aed7.explanation: RBI Governor ne Maharashtra mein ek financial inclusion camp ka udghatan kiya hai, jisme re-KYC par mukhya focus rakha gaya. Saath hi unhone wahan maujood representatives se baat-cheet bhi ki. Zyada details ke liye original report dekhein.

6b018934330947d6c677527b31ca6de9a8258e20.explanation: CBIC ne GST kanoon mein badlaav ke liye draft proposals pesh kiye hain. Inka maqsad genuine buyers ko input tax credit (ITC) ke nuksan se bachana hai, jo suppliers ke invalid claims ki wajah se hota hai. Saath hi, ye naye badlaav fraudulent invoicing par rok lagane ke liye laye ja rahe hain.

5fae11012b9e26b17c9408c0bb22626406527a5a.hinglish_title: Gokul Ne Badhaye Doodh Ke Daam, Bhains Ka Doodh ₹6 Aur Gaye Ka ₹4 Hua Mehenga
5fae11012b9e26b17c9408c0bb22626406527a5a.explanation: Gokul Milk Union ne bhains ke doodh ki selling price mein ₹6 prati litre aur gaye ke doodh mein ₹4 prati litre ki badtari ki hai. Chairman Rajesh Patil ke mutabik, sookhe ki sthiti aur kisano ki mushkilon ko dekhte hue sabhi 25 directors ne milkar ye faisla liya hai. Iske alawa, doodh utpadako ke liye procurement rates mein bhi bhains ke doodh par ₹3 aur gaye ke doodh par ₹2 prati litre ki badtari ki gayi hai. Naye daam 21 November se lagoo hokar March tak lagbhag 131 dino tak laagu rahenge.

7c43d60d28359e06c0da8ee6ecbf6bd73f042a16.explanation: Hero FinCorp ne aane wale do timahiyo mein apna loan disbursement volume double karne ka lakshya rakha hai. Company ne is saal January se September ke dauran northern India mein 4.80 lakh se zyada loans baante hain. Is plan ko unke diversified portfolio, distribution network aur AI-led underwriting system se support milega. Company retail, MSME aur corporate sectors ki financing zaroorato ko poora karti hai.

14054e9178ebb46fe349e9bf07419f88bd63fc0f.hinglish_title: Singur Mein Truck Plant Lagayegi Ashok Leyland, Kaam Jald Shuru: Sukanta Majumdar
14054e9178ebb46fe349e9bf07419f88bd63fc0f.explanation: Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar ne kaha hai ki Ashok Leyland Singur mein ek truck manufacturing plant lagane ja rahi hai. Is project par kaam jald shuru hone ki ummeed hai, jisse lagbhag do dashak pehle band hue Tata Nano project ke baad wahan dobara industrialisation ki ummeed jagi hai. Is proposed plant mein heavy vehicles ka production kiya jayega. Unhone kaha ki sarkar Singur mein dobara industries lane ke liye committed hai.

52665ed620c9a5ef9f505dd33a088fe9284b0a43.explanation: Tata Trusts ke chairman Noel Tata ne 20 November ko ek letter bhejkar 17 September ki meeting ke minutes ko challenge kiya hai. Unhone isme conflict-of-interest ke concerns uthaye hain. Saath hi unhone listing ke mudde par Tata Sons aur RBI ke beech hui baat-cheet par bhi sawal khade kiye hain.

9061ebb04c9c1a255c2812931db05f1ceba7add5.hinglish_title: E-Way Bill System Mein Metro Rail Bana Transport Ka 5th Mode
9061ebb04c9c1a255c2812931db05f1ceba7add5.explanation: GST Network (GSTN) ne e-way bill system mein ab Metro Rail ko naye transport mode ke roop mein shamil kiya hai. Is naye jod ke baad system mein Road, Rail, Air, Ship aur Metro Rail samet kul paanch modes ho gaye hain. Ye facility abhi API users ke liye sandbox environment mein testing ke liye available hai, jabki web users isse transport details update kar sakte hain. GST ke tehat ₹50,000 ya usse zyada ke saaman ke transit par e-way bill mandatory hota hai.

aec2fc5a12d8143644e4f7b99f7a56a3a040f02d.hinglish_title: Dalmia Cement Case: Mining Lease Tribal Land Rights Ko Override Nahi Kar Sakti: Supreme Court
aec2fc5a12d8143644e4f7b99f7a56a3a040f02d.explanation: Supreme Court ne faisla diya hai ki koi bhi mining lease Gram Sabha aur prabhavit parivaron ki zaroori sahmati ko override nahi kar sakti. Ye sahmati 2013 ke land acquisition kanoon ke tehat ahem hai. Is faisle ne Scheduled Areas mein adivasiyon ke zameen sambandhi adhikaaro aur safeguards ko aur mazboot kiya hai.

4cfeb11bf8beadb5e9b3d14451529278470a2d30.hinglish_title: Adani Energy West Bengal Ko 25 Saalo Ke Liye Degi 2,500 MW Renewable Power

Is 1,750 MW capacity ke liye supply 1 July 2028 se shuru hone ka schedule hai. Green shoe option exercise hone par bachi hui 750 MW ki supply 1 April 2029 se shuru hogi.

25069d027ae0709b18c21fc95a70865ffeafc3e9.explanation: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) ne is mahine ab tak Indian stock markets mein ₹1,11,950 crore ka bhaari nivesh kiya hai. Is inflow se domestic market ko kaafi support mil raha hai. Zyada details ke liye original report dekhein.

da6a13615a5b3ce6ba1372ff0704632f4b9cd046.hinglish_title: FPIs Ke Liye Additional Disclosure Rules Hatane Ka Sebi Ka Prastav
da6a13615a5b3ce6ba1372ff0704632f4b9cd046.explanation: Sebi ne foreign portfolio investors ke liye compliance aasan banane ke maqsad se ek naya prastav rakha hai. Iske tehat 2023 mein laye gaye granular beneficial ownership disclosures ko hatane ka sujhav diya gaya hai. Market regulator ne is kadam ke peeche global competitiveness ka hawala diya hai.

7d6a597fb62c0b71debf32f4bb9bb0714e8909ca.hinglish_title: Siemens Ke Margins Par Rehega Dabaav, Inflation Aur Forex Volatility Bani Wajah
7d6a597fb62c0b71debf32f4bb9bb0714e8909ca.explanation: Strong order inflows aur revenue growth ke chalte Siemens ka outlook mazboot bana hua hai. Lekin commodity inflation, forex volatility aur weak segment margins ki wajah se nazdeeki samay mein company ki profitability par asar pad sakta hai. Inhi wajahon se short term mein margins par dabaav rehne ki sambhavna hai.

f10985708674b0f7c5800e15a9cb99ddd1142cf1.hinglish_title: Paint companies ko Q3 mein mazboot demand ki ummeed, par margins par pressure barkarar
f10985708674b0f7c5800e15a9cb99ddd1142cf1.explanation: Festivals aur weddings ke chalte paint companies ko Q3FY27 mein behtar demand aur volume growth ki ummeed hai. Halanki, input cost badhne ki wajah se unke margins par abhi bhi dabav bana hua hai. Companies ne prices badhaye hain, par yeh cost inflation ko poori tarah cover nahi kar paaye hain.
